facts: A pair of threshold objects (Steel joint (kinetic)) stands 1.0-3.0 m inside the door, with a hanging screen (decontamination veil) between them; the route slips through a 1.9 m gap.
The hero (zero gravity monolith) stands alone in an empty 8 x 7 m area (the central void); the route circles it and never comes closer than 3.3 m.
Four product stations (eyewear display pods) sit at the outer corners, outside the loop, so you turn away from the hero to reach them.
The pay desk (docking station console) closes the loop at the back wall.
anchors: standing just inside the door, between the threshold objects; you look at the Steel joint (kinetic) (joint_column)
at the edge of the void, facing the hero; you look at the zero gravity monolith (box)
turned away from the hero, at a product station; you look at the eyewear display pods (display)

args.title: Orbital Hangar 01
args.subtitle: A zero-gravity docking experience.
args.line: You drift through the station's hangar, where eyewear suspended in zero gravity becomes a celestial encounter.
args.synopsis: You enter through the decontamination veil and find yourself floating in the sterile expanse of the hangar. Before you, the zero gravity monolith commands the central void, suspending eyewear in an artificial vacuum. You move around the perimeter like a craft docking to a station, your focus captured by the precision of the display pods. As you reach the back, your journey concludes at the console, completing your orbital alignment.
args.quote: Weightlessness is the ultimate luxury of form.
why: The metallic pylons and light-filtered threshold prepare you for the transition from gravity to a weightless environment.
The central monolith acts as a gravitational anchor, forcing you to orbit the core of the space.
The outer stations provide a sense of grounded functionality, contrasting with the ethereal central display.
The console at the back provides a final anchor, grounding the experience before you leave the station.
